subject: Decision signals, procurement gates, and next steps (post-demo recap)
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@luminatehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: decision criteria + procurement ask

Hi Rachel / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. The execs found the latency / caching approach interesting, but we have a short checklist we need to validate before we can move to procurement: 

- Economic buyer: we think Daniel Ortiz (VP Product) will sign off but need confirmation.
- Security: SOC 2 evidence + answers to a few data residency questions.
- Legal: standard data processing addendum + acceptable indemnity terms.
- Procurement gates: procurement intake form + 3 quotes for budget approval.
- Decision criteria: latency at p95, hosted vs private deployment options, cost per 1M tokens, and rollback/fallback story.

Can you send a concise stakeholder map (who needs to approve what), the SOW draft you mentioned, and a brief security Q&A? If possible, we need that by EOD Thursday (US). I can route to procurement once we have the attachments.

Also looped below: Daniel O. (heads product) — Daniel, do you want to confirm your team’s priorities?

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Li
Director, Platform Innovation
Luminate Health
[Attachment: procurement-intake-form.docx (application/msword)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 18:04:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-demo follow-up: decision criteria + procurement ask

Emma — great to hear the demo landed. Quick responses below and attached materials.

1) Economic buyer: per our call, we believe Daniel Ortiz is the economic buyer; marking him as primary approver in the stakeholder map attached. If Daniel prefers someone else, flag and we’ll update.

2) Stakeholder map (attached):
- Daniel Ortiz (VP Product) — economic buyer, product impact / ROI sign-off
- Procurement team (procurement@luminatehealth.com) — intake + vendor evaluation
- Security (security@luminatehealth.com — named contact TBD) — SOC2/evidence + data residency acceptance
- Legal (legal@luminatehealth.com) — contract redlines
- DevOps/Platform (eng leads) — deployment & network review

3) Next steps / timeline we propose:
- Wed (1/6): we’ll share SOW v1 + security Q&A (answers to your list).
- Thu (1/7): procurement intake + pricing sheet for 90-day pilot pricing (we can include private deployment options).
- Mon (1/11): follow-up call with Daniel + procurement to align final procurement gate.

Attachments included: Luminate_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW), security-qsa-response.xlsx (spreadsheet of answers).

Notes on pricing: for an initial pilot we can offer a time-boxed 90-day pilot with reduced pilot pricing; Ben has the negotiated bands.

If that timeline looks tight, tell me the latest date you need and we’ll adjust.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive — Healthcare & Regulated
Redwood Inference

Rachel / team —

Thanks for moving quickly on the artifacts. A few internal pointers before we send formal pricing to procurement: 

- Pilot pricing: recommend the 90-day pilot with a clear exit economics section (what happens to token billing after pilot). Put a renewal trigger and a cap on pilot spend.
- Legal redlines we expect: DPA, liability cap (we usually negotiate to 1–2x fees for SaaS), and a clear data deletion clause for pilot data.
- Security: add a one-page summary of our SOC2 coverage and where logs/audit retention live (helps procurement speed review).

Marissa — can you own a short pricing note that explains pilot -> committed capacity flow? We should include two options: hosted API with quotas, and dedicated pool with reserved slots (estimated RPS and cost).

Rachel — when you send the next email to Emma/Daniel, call out the procurement contact they should share so we can send the intake with pricing. Also flag the HubSpot deal id (RDW-2026-LH-0042) so procurement references it.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the clear summary. Confirming a few things from my side:

- Procurement contact: procurement@luminatehealth.com (copied here) — they want the intake form + 3 quotes by Thu (1/7) to hit our weekly procurement review.
- Key legal asks: data residency in us-east-1 preferred for pilot, standard DPA + confidentiality addendum.
